chunks: if you have purchased this house from money other than yours or paid the price from an unlawful source, you have incurred loss of this world as well as of the next.
If you had come to me at the time of purchase I would have written for you a document on this paper and then you would not have liked to purchase the house even for one Dirham, not to speak of more.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of buying a house with unlawful money according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advises his judge Shurayh to ensure that the money used to purchase his house was earned through lawful means, warning that unlawful funds jeopardize both worldly and spiritual success. He offers to provide a written guarantee of this principle, emphasizing that financial integrity is foundational to judicial and personal righteousness. This advice reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the purity of wealth as a prerequisite for valid worship and leadership.
